2607.17632.title: TypiCore: A Hybrid Active Query Strategy for Class-Incremental Learning on Time Series
2607.17632.paper_summary: Time series data play a pivotal role across numerous domains, including healthcare and manufacturing. In real-world environments, models must cope with distribution shifts over time, a challenge commonly addressed through Continual Learning (CL) techniques. However, existing CL methods face a critical limitation: real-world data streams are rarely fully labeled, making annotation cost a major practical constraint. This paper investigates Active Class-Incremental Learning (ACIL) for multivariate time series, where a model must sequentially learn new classes while selectively querying labels under a fixed annotation budget. We present a systematic evaluation of a wide range of query strategies combined with multiple rehearsal-based approaches, assessing their impact on plasticity, stability, and label efficiency across four benchmark datasets. Our analysis reveals the limitations of uncertainty-based and distribution-aware methods in achieving strong performance under constrained labeling budgets. To address these shortcomings, we propose TypiCore, a novel hybrid query strategy that alternates between typicality-based and diversity-based sample selection across active learning cycles, enabling the construction of memory buffers that are both representative and diverse. Evaluated on the TSCIL benchmark, TypiCore delivers statistically significant improvements over all baselines and matches or surpasses fully supervised continual learning performance on multiple datasets while requiring a fraction of the available labels.
2607.17632.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列數據在多個領域中扮演著關鍵角色，包括醫療保健和製造業。<lb/>在現實環境中，模型必須應對隨時間變化的分佈轉變，這是一個通常通過持續學習（CL）技術來解決的挑戰。<lb/>然而，現有的CL方法面臨一個關鍵限制：現實世界中的數據流很少是完全標記的，這使得標註成本成為一個主要的實際限制。<lb/>本文研究了多變量時間序列的主動類別增量學習（ACIL），在這種情況下，模型必須在固定的標註預算下，順序學習新類別，同時選擇性地查詢標籤。<lb/>我們對多種查詢策略與多個基於重複訓練的方法進行了系統評估，評估它們在四個基準數據集上的可塑性、穩定性和標籤效率的影響。<lb/>我們的分析揭示了基於不確定性和分佈感知的方法在有限標註預算下實現強大性能的限制。<lb/>為了解決這些不足，我們提出了TypiCore，一種新穎的混合查詢策略，該策略在主動學習循環中交替進行基於典型性和基於多樣性的樣本選擇，從而構建既具代表性又具多樣性的記憶緩衝區。<lb/>在TSCIL基準上評估後，TypiCore在所有基準上均顯著提高了性能，並在多個數據集上達到或超越了完全監督的持續學習性能，同時只需使用可用標籤的一小部分。
